WITH resultados AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM ana_buscar_precos(
    (
      SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(x), ARRAY[]::text[])
      FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(($1::jsonb)->'exames') AS x
    )
  )
),
normalizados AS (
  SELECT
    r.*,
    lower(trim(regexp_replace(r.termo_busca, '^\s*dosagem\s+d(e|o|a|os|as)\s+', '', 'i'))) AS termo_limpo,
    lower(r.nome_exame) AS nome_limpo,
    lower(COALESCE(substring(r.termo_busca FROM '\(([^)]+)\)'), '')) AS sigla
  FROM resultados r
  WHERE r.encontrado = true
    AND r.ativo = true
    AND r.preco IS NOT NULL
    AND r.similaridade >= 0.35
),
ranqueados AS (
  SELECT
    n.*,
    row_number() OVER (
      PARTITION BY n.termo_busca
      ORDER BY
        (
          CASE
            WHEN n.sigla <> '' AND n.nome_limpo LIKE '%' || n.sigla || '%' THEN 3
            ELSE 0
          END
          +
          CASE
            WHEN n.nome_limpo LIKE '%' || n.termo_limpo || '%'
              OR n.termo_limpo LIKE '%' || n.nome_limpo || '%' THEN 2
            ELSE 0
          END
          + n.similaridade
        ) DESC,
        n.similaridade DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM normalizados n
)
SELECT
  termo_busca,
  nome_exame,
  categoria,
  preco,
  preco_pix,
  ativo,
  similaridade,
  encontrado
FROM ranqueados
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY termo_busca;

WITH p AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS j),
eco AS (
  SELECT 1 FROM ana_mensagens m, p
  WHERE m.phone = p.j->>'phone'
    AND m.role = 'assistant'
    AND m.created_at > now() - interval '10 minutes'
    AND length(COALESCE(p.j->>'conteudo','')) > 0
    AND position(p.j->>'conteudo' IN COALESCE(m.conteudo,'')) > 0
  LIMIT 1
),
upd AS (
  UPDATE ana_leads l
  SET bot_ativo = false, human_msg_at = now(), escalado = false, updated_at = now()
  FROM p
  WHERE l.phone = p.j->>'phone'
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM eco)
  RETURNING l.phone
),
ins AS (
  INSERT INTO ana_mensagens (phone, role, tipo, conteudo)
  SELECT p.j->>'phone', 'assistant', 'humano', COALESCE(NULLIF(p.j->>'conteudo',''), '[mensagem da equipe]')
  FROM p
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM eco)
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM upd) AS pausados;
